Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
Glory be to the Possessor of lofty and exalted might
Glory be to the Possessor of sublime and magnificent majesty
Glory be to the Possessor of splendid and eternal kingdom

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ يَرىٰ أَثَرَ النَّمْلَةِ فِيْ الصَّفَا
Translation: Glory be to He who sees the traces of an ant on solid rock

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ يَرىٰ وَقْعَ الطَّيْرِ فِيْ الْهَوَاءِ
Translation: Glory be to He who sees the flight of birds in the air

Arabic text: سُبْحَانَ مَنْ هُوَ هٰكَذَا وَلَا هٰكَذَا غَيْرُهُ
Translation: Glory be to He who is thus, and none other is like Him
